answer.rationale: Rolling back is out (compliance), failover shifts writes away from healthy region, circuit breaker on writes would lose customer writes (violates objective). Read replica routing is for dashboards, not write path. Add capacity is the only option that addresses the p99 climb without dropping writes. memory_b5 confirms read replicas recovered write latency on primary, supporting the principle that relieving primary pressure helps writes — but the actual lever here is adding capacity (memory_b5's pattern is analogous, not directly applicable). Rolling back the release is ruled out by compliance (memory_b1 about rollback success is informational only — not actionable here).
